name: Random Gem Generator
description: Accepts any topic and returns a randomly generated gem — type, rarity, and a unique descriptor.

run.description: Generate a random gem based on the given topic

topic.description: The topic or theme to base the gem on

gem.description: The name of the generated gem

rarity.description: Rarity tier: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, or Legendary

descriptor.description: A unique flavour description of the gem
